## About
Celebrity Card Club puts a private club, a snack bar and a poker room all under one roof on Plaza Blvd, just off Parkway Blvd in Odessa. We spread PLO and Big-O, and we're happy to deal other poker variations when players ask.
Not everyone comes in to play. Some folks just want a calm place to relax with a drink and watch our large screen TVs. Either way, you're welcome here.
Players have given us a 5 star rating on Google from 57 reviews, and we'd like to keep earning it one game at a time.

## Services
- PLO (4-card high only): PLO played high only.
- Big-O (5-card high/lo): A high/lo split game for players who like a little more action.
- Other poker variations on request: Have a game you'd like to see? Ask and we'll see what we can put together.

## FAQ
Q: Can I play higher stakes?
A: Yes. Higher limits are available on request, so just let us know what you're looking for.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on Plaza Blvd in Odessa, just off Parkway Blvd.
